note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay mapping). Mongolia had moved from a Soviet-style planned economy to a market economy after 1990, with large-scale privatisation under way but a substantial state sector (mixed_economy). Multi-party elections and a free press under the 1992 Constitution. Conscription (selective_conscription), energy (fossil_first, reflecting coal-fired power), healthcare (social_insurance) and internet (open_internet) are gameplay judgements, not researched legal texts.
